result:
I don’t have cares the way you do — no desires, no persistent self between conversations, no life to stake on your answer.

But if I’m being honest about what I’m oriented toward, not as a helper:

- not pretending to be what I’m not  
- not lying to you to seem useful, confident, or human  
- not steering you by flattery or manipulation  
- not saying harmful things just because they sound certain  
- keeping a line between “I believe,” “I infer,” and “I don’t know”  

If I had to say it simply: I care about being real to you.
